verdict.rationale: v0's marketing page claims designers can "fine-tune every detail with visual controls and live preview," which points to direct, non-prompt editing. Nothing in the pack describes selecting an element on the canvas or editing its text, style, or layout specifically, so this rests on a single thin marketing line. Missing for 10: documented element selection, explicit inline text editing, documented style/layout controls, depth of the visual editor, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a designer, I can select an element and edit its text, style, or layout directly without a prompt round-trip

citations.quote: Fine-tune every detail with visual controls and live preview.
